 Order
This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

12.
2. Heard Mr. B.N. Mohanty, learned counsel for the Petitioners and Mr. S. Nayak, learned Additional Standing Counsel appearing for the State.

3. The Petitioners have filed this application seeking direction to the Opposite Parties to take necessary action under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 by awarding adequate compensation and rehabilitation benefit to them, within a stipulated time.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 4. Mr. B.N. Mohanty, learned counsel for the Petitioners contended that so far as the compensation is concerned, the Petitioners have no grievance, but the Petitioners claim rehabilitation benefit, as admissible to them, within a stipulated time.

5. Considering the contention raised by learned counsel for the Petitioners and after going through the records, this writ petition stands disposed of directing the Opposite Parties to consider the claim of the Petitioners with regard to grant of rehabilitation benefit, if it is permissible under the scheme applicable to the Petitioners.
6. With the aforesaid observation, the writ petition stands disposed of.
